title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30270: expose JobPostLine before calculating totals
summary: Sales invoice posting exposes a new event that provides access to the Job Post-Line instance before calculating totals, enabling extensions to interact with job data during the posting process.
key_points: New event OnPostLinesOnBeforeCalcSums in Sales Post Invoice Events codeunit
Event fires before TempInvoicePostingBuffer.CalcSums in the PostLines method
Provides subscribers with posting context and active Job Post-Line instance
Implemented across all localization layers (W1, APAC, BE, ES, FI, IT, NA, RU)
Allows extensions to access job data without changing existing procedure signatures
quote: Extensions need access to the active Job Post-Line instance while sales invoice posting still retains its prepared job data.
